verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll/PEO platform, so sending offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and storing them per employee is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, PEO enrollment and the Xero integration. It contains no mention of offer letters, e-signature, or per-employee document storage; the references to employee profiles concern payroll data checks, not document storage.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
